name: @backup-manager/ugos-upk-proof
description: Standalone minimal React/JSSDK frontend for issue #91 (B1.2): proves a packaged UGOS Docker App can boot, talk to the real @ugreen-nas/core JSSDK, and reach the bare backend's /health/live. Deliberately not wired into ui/shared's provider-neutral build (see apps/ugos/docs/upk-proof-procedure.md) or the shared PlatformBridge contract from B1.1 — this is throwaway packaging-proof code, not the real UGOS provider app (#83).
